answer: Traffic-Shape Mirror Windows. Each identity must emit a clocked heartbeat whose inter-arrival jitter, when reflected against the population’s median shape, stays within a tolerance band; the mirror comparison is continuous, not one-off. A comet of burst traffic from fresh identities breaks the band and flags them. To pass, an attacker must sustain organic-looking pacing across many identities, paying continuous compute and coordination cost per identity, plus delayed activation of any relic account until its timing converges.
